text: なかまが　だまっちゃ　いねえぞ

structure.jp: だまっちゃ　いねえぞ

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.span: だまっちゃ　いねえ
patterns.explanation: This is a rough, slurred way of saying だまっては　いない: ちゃ is short for ては and いねえ is tough-guy いない. だまっちゃ　いねえ = 'won't be keeping quiet'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, forceful speech, here used as a threat. いねえぞ = 'they won't, I warn you!'
